question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She raced ______ towards the train.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**Frantically'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Frantically** means **hurried and disorderly manner. **(जल्दबाजी और अव्यवस्थित तरीके से)

 
 
• Example, ***most of the students write in a frantic fashion **just before the time is over for the exam,** thus making mistakes***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, **She raced frantically towards the train.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Crazily** means **behaving erratically and wildly. **(गलत और बेतहाशा व्यवहार करना)

 
 
• Example, ***the audience sang crazily at the last event.***
 
 
 
• **Berserk** means **out of control. **(नियंत्रण से बाहर)
 
 
• Example, ***our uncle's dog goes berserk often which is why he is on a leash at all times***.
 
 
 
• **Hectically** means **engaged or busy**. (व्यस्त)
 
 
• Example, ***all administration jobs require employees to work hectically***.
